title.narrative: Raising awareness of children and youth about the activities of biosphere reserves in the context of the Berezinsky Biosphere Reserve

description.narrative: The project is an educational one, aimed at developing in children and youth a value-based attitude towards nature, increasing their level of environmental education, awareness on issues of environmental protection and rational use of natural resources, nurturing a responsible attitude of the younger generation towards nature, and developing environmentally literate behavior. The project will be implemented by organizing and conducting a training workshop for children and youth and preparing an illustrated popular and science bilingual publication for a wide range of readers, including children, which will contain background and scientific information, photographs of natural landscapes, ecosystems, as well as species of animals, plants and mushrooms. The project is timed to coincide with the 100th anniversary of the founding of the Berezinsky Biosphere Reserve and the 45th anniversary of its assignment to the status of a biosphere reserve, and therefore will also raise awareness among the younger generation about the Man and the Biosphere Programme of UNESCO (MAB), the activities of biosphere reserves and, in general, about the activities of UNESCO in the fields of science and education.
